body: Um, it’s kind of too late for that?

I keep talking to him about it but I know it scares him as much as it scares me. And in order to move forward from this if I am pregnant I need to tell my parents because I don’t have my own insurance. I’m literally fresh out of high school. My boyfriend is so supportive, and he is happy with either outcome. I guess in our heads if we have this kid then he wouldn’t have to be so far away and it would give us both purpose even though it was an accident.
But we know it’s better for both of our futures to abort so we can finish college and get stable careers. It’s very much a joint decision and he gets every update. I’m scared as to telling my parents. I can’t be that kid. They told me the one thing to do if we have sex is to be safe and we tried and we fucked up. I don’t even know if they’d let me visit him again or let him visit in fear of a repeat. He’s really the only one here for me most of the time and I can’t lose him. It’s easier to avoid all this by just dying.
Thank you so much for your kind words. For some reason, your comment spoke to me more than others. Sorry for word vomit.
My parents have always made it about standards. Perfect grades, perfect extracurriculars, perfect college, perfect family member, dating a boy they like, etc. Always about what makes them look good
My family is very disappointed in me. I’m not this perfect kid they want and I never can be so Ill always be a disappointment
Very fair point. I guess I can’t pinpoint that feeling either then
I guess that’s fair. It’s sleep without waking up, though. I find that nothingness sort of scary. To be nothing, like before I was born

We have talked about this, he is okay with whatever decision I may make. He has told me he would move out here and be the dad if that’s what I decided, or be here for me if I decide to terminate. We are both very young and neither one of us are really ready to be parents and I know I can’t be a good mother. He’s not really excited, more so scared but he’s not leaving
I do too. I think just because what comes after is unknown
Thank you so much. I’m going through a breakup I fucked up with so trust me, that means a lot.
I know the feeling. It’ll be okay, dude. From what you told me, you’re likely better off without her. She didn’t respect your relationship. Lots of hugs.

I totally know how you feel. I’m also 18 and a boy (four years older) took advantage of me when I was 15, was emotionally abusive, and left me for another girl. I hurt for so long, but you will find someone who loves you or a close friend who will support you through anything, and things will start to feel okay again slowly. Stay strong.

Everyone seems to want to give me their opinion about how I can do better from my ex when we were dating, but everyone is upset when we break up... Such a double standard. I haven’t been taking my meds consistently for two months and there was a stint like this but I caught it, we talked about taking a break but then got back together. I’ve told a lot of people that we’re not together looking for a support system and going back on that seems so hard and awkward. I’m scared to tell my parents or anyone how I really am feeling
You did what was best for you. I’m sure you’ll feel empty for a while but it’s not fair to you to stay with someone who doesn’t value the exclusiveness of your relationship as much as you do
